title: fix(update): reject unverifiable session listings after activation
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Immutable activation could be reported as verified while `sessions.list` failed, even though `/healthz`, `/readyz`, and the health RPC succeeded.

## User Impact

Verification now requires one authenticated compact session listing (`limit: 1`) from the verified Gateway boot. RPC errors and malformed results leave the activation unverified; an empty session list is valid. Existing timeout, failure, and recovery behavior remains in charge.

## Why This Change Was Made

HTTP readiness alone does not prove that the session store can serve requests. The verifier uses the existing read-only auth and TLS owners, checks the boot at dispatch and completion, and retains its final process/generation reconciliation. There are no descriptor, control-record, model-marker, plugin-policy, or bridge changes.

Diff: **2 files, +98/-2**; production **+67/-0**. This correctness fix adds a previously missing application check, so there is no superseded production path to remove. It adds one bounded RPC per verification, not a polling loop.

## Evidence

Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m4kaq5zjc6bzgg8yvt05ywfw` (`blacksmith-testbox`, `openclaw-check`):

- Regression against unchanged production code: HTTP 200 plus a failing session listing incorrectly returned `verified`; the new regression failed as intended.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/update-immutable-verification.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **15 passed**, 21.64 s wall time (19.08 s Vitest, mostly transform). This includes valid empty-list acceptance and existing replacement-boot checks.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` for the other nine `update-immutable*.test.ts` files: **116 passed, 9 existing skips**, 20.36 s wall time.
- On rebased main, all ten immutable-updater test files: **140 passed, 12 existing skips**, 35.48 s wall time.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --staged`: all pre-compiler guards passed; blocked by the existing UI end-to-end root budget (722 roots versus 720). The same failure was reproduced with the patch removed from a clean `9c37dbf3e90b1717b7013b0a47c64e25300c5b55` checkout on Testbox `tbx_01m4kbnp9d509przsnfmqm29kj`.
- On that lease, `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo` and `node scripts/run-tsgo-core-test-shards.mjs --stripe 1/1 --concurrency 4` passed: core production types plus all **27 test typecheck groups**.
- Remaining checks: targeted lint (zero warnings/errors), native schema guard, coercion/deprecated-API guards, legacy-store/media/sidecar guards, runtime import cycles, webhook, and pairing guards passed.
- Export scan has three inherited failures: `tools/solid-lint/index.mjs` default export and `resolveSessionConversationStub` / `resolveSessionTargetStub` in `sessions-channel-fixture.test-support.ts`. All three reproduced on the same clean main baseline with the patch removed.
- Independent Codex review: no actionable P0/P1 findings.

No live Gateway deployment was performed. This is a verification correctness fix; no throughput improvement is claimed.

CI run `38071657955` on exact head `a1ee1cf1643c5d1f2026609695d5ef0bf5066c59` was cancelled by fail-fast after the unrelated `check-lint` job failed at `scripts/lib/managed-cleanup-handoff.mts:224` (`consistent-return`). That source is unchanged between the tested merge and its main parent `fa95932d442fd3aa82ae4fe01dd0b9ac5abdf993`. The same single-file lint failure reproduced on a clean checkout of that exact main parent on Testbox `tbx_01m4ke0bxbfbw50c9pm0t8h4h4` (34.08 s including baseline setup; lint 6.1 s). Landing uses the authorized inherited-failure exception; cancelled CI jobs are not claimed as passing.
